scope.measured: requestAnimationFrame intervals, CPU simulation, Canvas submission, actual GameAudio event submission, 10 Hz HUD snapshot, post-GC JS heap, exact loaded image/audio bytes.
scope.schedule: Actual authored waves activated at t=0, up to three real actors killed through native damageEnemy; player placed at ground level in the densest candidate window centered on authored actors, without moving enemies or props. Remaining native AI/geometry/collision enabled; player invulnerability 1e6 seconds prevents no-op dead scenes.
scope.comparison: Repeated seeded scenes on the same browser, viewport, DPR, assets, audio mix, warmup and inputs. Initial qaPrepare asset loading is outside frame timing; native sector preloading remains active during measurements and can include later load/decode work. Pass 1 and pass 2 have different cache histories. Selected-state digests compare elapsed/phase, player position/health, enemy position/health/activity, corpses and receipts; they do not cover the entire GameState. No optimization before/after claimed.
scope.timing: One fixed 1/60 native update per observed rAF; delayed frames slow fixture simulation instead of accumulator catch-up. CPU submission is not GPU duration or physical display latency.
scope.memory: CDP forces GC outside timed regions before both samples. JSHeapUsedSize excludes image/GPU/audio backing allocations and total browser process RSS. The audit Map retains one image per unique URL across missions. Repeated-scene samples do not alone establish leak freedom.
scope.audio: Native GameAudio, manifest-backed authored SFX and intended procedural biome ambience; decoded/playing diagnostics establish transport, not a human listening review.

drawDiagnostic.interpretation: Static final scene; per-drawImage wrapper adds measurement overhead. This diagnostic is excluded from frame benchmarks and identifies synchronous Canvas submission costs only.

frameBudget60Hz.interpretation: Observed reference-runner budget only; PASS status denotes valid execution/integrity/comparisons, not a frame-budget pass.
